purpose: Transparent recheck of confidence selection and prototype selection followed by the same mixed-label CE training.
manuscript_policy: Do not modify paper sources or replace historical manuscript numbers with these independent reruns.
selection_policy: Choose learning rate by maximum validation accuracy only; retain every trial regardless of which method wins. Do not target a prescribed number of winning datasets.
labels: Original CLIP predictions; simulate correction only on selected indices. Both methods query the exact same number of labels, as specified by each dataset's controlled prototype mask.

training.features: Frozen OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14; normalized by existing cache loader
training.classifier: Existing LinearHead, Xavier uniform weights and zero bias
training.objective: Cross entropy on all mixed hard targets
training.tie_break: Lowest learning rate among equal maximum validation accuracies
training.checkpoint_selection: First epoch attaining maximum validation accuracy
training.test_policy: Existing training CLI evaluates test at the validation-selected checkpoint; test metrics never enter the learning-rate selector. Save all trial outputs.

execution.existing_gpu_queues: Keep current source, HEAD, configuration files and processes unchanged

known_limitations: These controlled caches cannot be proven identical to all historical manuscript inputs.
Recovered Caltech has 101 classes; manuscript reports a 102-class protocol.
CPU reruns are distinct from the historical GPU implementation settings and are recorded explicitly.
Seed 42 is used for validation-based tuning and included in the three-seed summary; seed variability is conditional on the selected learning rate, fixed data, labels and correction masks.
The confidence-threshold CLI argument does not affect clip_conf_ce; it is not a tuning variable for this campaign.
Current label-only audit favors confidence selection on all five datasets; the downstream comparison is allowed to favor either method.
